newsitem.title: USA: Donnkenny shareholders file suit - lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Donnkenny shareholders file suit - lawyers.

text.p: Donnkenny Inc shareholders have filed a class action lawsuit against the company alleging violations of U.S. securities law, the plaintiff's lawyers said on Wednesday.
The suit was filed on behalf of purchasers of Donnkenny Inc common stock during the period of April 4, 1994 through November 8, 1996, or the so-called class period.

The lawyers said the complaint charged the company and its officers issued a series of materially false and misleading public statements concerning Donnkenny's financial results for 1994, 1995 and the first two quarters of 1996.
The complaint alleged that the company reported record sales and income during the class period which were materially inflated by premature revenue recognition, the company said.
Plaintiffs, represented by the law firm of Pomerantz Haudek Block & Grossman sought to recover damages on behalf of the shareholders.
